description: Before you edit a UI file, get only the design context it needs: tokens the file already uses, tokens its neighbours use, the scale steps for the kinds of values it contains (spacing, type, radius), components in the same folder or already imported that you should reuse, the drift already in it, and the team's decisions (values they chose to keep, which you must not replace, and values they always want flagged). Much smaller than the full token list. Then write values from it and run check_ui_against_design_system on the file.

file.description: Repository-relative or absolute path of the file you are about to edit (it may not exist yet)

name: context_for_file
title: Design context for the file you are editing
